title.hr: Upravljanje poslovima: fg, bg, Ctrl-Z i odjava
title.en: Job control: fg, bg, Ctrl-Z and logging out

concept.hr: Posao je grupa procesa; tipke idu prednjoj grupi, SIGHUP svim poslovima
concept.en: A job is a process group; keys go to the foreground group, SIGHUP to every job

summary.hr: Pokreni poslove naprijed i u pozadini, obustavi ih s Ctrl-Z, vrati s fg i bg, pa zatvori prozor ili upiši exit i vidi što preživi.
summary.en: Run jobs in the foreground and background, stop them with Ctrl-Z, bring them back with fg and bg, then close the window or type exit and see what survives.
